description: The figure presents two multi-level (nested donut) pie charts that summarize and compare clustering statistics for two methods, with the left chart titled “AttentionInfluence” and the right chart titled “FineWeb-Edu Classifier,” each showing an inner ring of broad clusters and an outer ring of finer subcategories whose numeric labels sum to 100 and thus read as percentages. In the left chart, the inner ring has 6 slices: Education (teal/green, 25), Health & Medicine (blue, 22), History & Society (orange, 23), Science (pink/red, 15), Tech & Engineer (brown, 12), and Fin & Law (dark blue, 3); the outer ring has 15 slices grouped by these inner categories: Teaching & resources (teal, 15) and Science & technology education (teal, 10) under Education; Diseases (blue, 11), Medical (blue, 6), and Nutrition (blue, 5) under Health & Medicine; Animal & Plant (pink/red, 13) and Materials (pink/red, 2) under Science; Society & culture (orange, 10), Historical review (orange, 7), and Events & people (orange, 6) under History & Society; Infor tech (brown, 5), Materials (brown, 3), and Emerging tech (brown, 4) under Tech & Engineer; and Manage (light blue, 2) plus Policy (light blue, 1) under Fin & Law, with several small slices annotated using leader lines. In the right chart, the inner ring also has 6 slices: Education (teal/green, 38), Health & Medicine (blue, 19), History & Society (orange, 19), Science (pink/red, 15), Tech & Engineer (brown, 8), and a very small Fin/Law-related slice indicated by the outer label Manage 1 (light blue, 1); the outer ring again has 15 slices: Teaching & resources (teal, 17), Science & technology education (teal, 19), and Healthy education (teal, 2) under Education; Diseases (blue, 10), Nutrition (blue, 7), and Medical (blue, 2) under Health & Medicine; Animal & Plant (pink/red, 12) and Materials (pink/red, 3) under Science; Historical review (orange, 12), Society & culture (orange, 5), and Events & people (orange, 2) under History & Society; Infor tech (brown, 3), Materials (brown, 1), and Emerging tech (brown, 4) under Tech & Engineer; and Manage (light blue, 1) shown as a tiny slice with a leader line. Both charts use direct labeling on or near slices (with callouts for small segments), have no separate legend, and show clear white boundaries between slices without a distinct exploded-offset effect beyond the visible separation lines, with slices arranged contiguously by their inner-ring groupings around the circle.
